title: Part 2 Practice: Demographic Measurements and Trends in Ethiopia

questions.text: What does Crude Birth Rate (CBR) measure?
options: A) Number of births per 1,000 women aged 15-49
B) Number of births per 1,000 population
D) Number of deaths per 1,000 population
questions.correct_answer: B) Number of births per 1,000 population
questions.explanation: Correct: CBR measures births per 1,000 total population. A is wrong—that's GFR. C is wrong—that's TFR. D is wrong—that's CDR.

questions.text: Ethiopia's Total Fertility Rate (TFR) in 2023 is approximately:
questions.explanation: Correct: Ethiopia's TFR is ~4.1 in 2023. A is wrong—that was 1990. B is wrong—that was 2005. D is wrong—that's too low for Ethiopia.

questions.text: Which mortality measure specifically focuses on deaths of infants under one year of age?
questions.explanation: Correct: IMR measures deaths of infants under 1 year. A is wrong—CDR measures all deaths. C is wrong—MMR measures maternal deaths. D is wrong—life expectancy measures years of life.

questions.text: What is the formula for the Natural Rate of Increase?
questions.explanation: Correct: Natural Rate of Increase = CBR - CDR. A is wrong—that would be addition. C is wrong—multiplication is not correct. D is wrong—TFR and IMR are different measures.

questions.text: Ethiopia's Infant Mortality Rate (IMR) has declined from approximately 115 per 1,000 in 1990 to what in 2023?
questions.explanation: Correct: IMR is ~43 per 1,000 in 2023. A is wrong—that was 2005. B is wrong—that was 2016. D is wrong—too low for current rate.

questions.text: What does the Total Fertility Rate (TFR) measure?
options: B) Average number of children a woman would have during her reproductive years
questions.correct_answer: B) Average number of children a woman would have during her reproductive years
questions.explanation: Correct: TFR measures average children per woman. A is wrong—that's CBR. C is wrong—that's CDR. D is wrong—that's MMR.

questions.text: Ethiopia's Maternal Mortality Rate (MMR) in 2023 is approximately:
questions.explanation: Correct: MMR is ~267 per 100,000 in 2023. A is wrong—that was 1990. B is wrong—that was 2005. C is wrong—that was 2016.

questions.text: Ethiopia's life expectancy at birth has increased from approximately 45 years in 1990 to what in 2023?
questions.explanation: Correct: Life expectancy is ~65-68 years in 2023. A is wrong—that was 2005. B is wrong—too low. C is wrong—too low.

questions.text: Ethiopia's population doubling time at the current growth rate of 2.5% is approximately:
questions.explanation: Correct: Doubling time = 70/2.5 = 28 years. A is wrong—too short. C is wrong—too long. D is wrong—too long.

questions.text: Which factor has contributed most to the decline in fertility rates in Ethiopia?
options: B) Improved female education and increased contraceptive use
questions.correct_answer: B) Improved female education and increased contraceptive use
questions.explanation: Correct: Education and contraception are key factors. A is wrong—urbanization is one factor but not the only one. C is wrong—earlier marriage would increase fertility. D is wrong—immigration doesn't directly affect fertility.
